properties.name: Deutsches Reich
properties.hgisAlignment: Compared against OSHistory hgis-germany-transformer correction lines; source already aligns substantially closer to correction targets, so the transform is not applied a second time.
properties.heligolandPatch: High-resolution modern coastlines: Helgoland from Pleiades-preserved OSM relation 3787052; Düne from OSM way 273992076.
properties.sourceLicense: HistoGIS CC BY 4.0; OSM-derived island coastlines ODbL 1.0
properties.normalization: Removed consecutive duplicate coordinates from source geometry where present; no shape-altering simplification applied.

northSeaDollartToJade.method: Conservative densification of the 1914 HistoGIS skeleton with processed OpenStreetMap coastline points only where the current coastline lies within 150 m of the historical skeleton segment; changed/reclaimed/harbour/estuary areas outside the threshold remain on the historical line.
northSeaDollartToJade.historicalBasis: HistoGIS German Empire 1871-1919 working skeleton; period control maps: Preußische Landesaufnahme/TK25 1877-1912.

properties.coastlineMode: Modern high-resolution website coastline for DEU/DNK/POL/RUS/LTU; intended for later replacement with reconstructed 1914 shoreline.
properties.landBorderMode: Existing historical working-base land borders retained; four coast/land junction vertices snapped to modern coastline.
notes: INTERIM geometry: modern coastline + historical working-base land borders.
North Sea modern coast: Netherlands/Germany coast junction to 1914 North Schleswig west land-border endpoint.
Baltic modern coast: 1914 North Schleswig east land-border endpoint to the 1914 German/Russian coast endpoint north of Memel.
Codex shoreline pass should later replace only the modern coastline portions with reconstructed 1914 shoreline and re-snap the four coastal land-border terminals.
Als is explicitly taken from the modern Danish geometry because it was part of the German Empire in 1914.
